name: Date Picker
summary: Date picker component composed from Popover and Calendar, with range, input, time and natural-language variants.
description: Documentation page for the shadcn/ui Date Picker, built as a composition of the Popover and Calendar components rather than a single root component. It shows usage and variants: basic, range picker, date of birth with a dropdown caption layout, input, time picker and a natural-language picker that parses dates with chrono-node, plus RTL support. Available for Base UI, React Aria and Radix.
contains: composition of Popover and Calendar, no separate Date Picker root
variants: basic, range, date of birth, input, time picker, natural-language, RTL
natural language date parsing via chrono-node
available for Base UI, React Aria and Radix
